subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should ClawHub publish this plugin verification envelope as a stable v1 API before the public vetted-community-plugin trust model is decided?
rationale: The endpoint creates a durable public trust boundary whose distinction between release evidence, current publisher policy, and endorsement semantics cannot be resolved mechanically from the existing implementation.

options.title: Defer the public v1 contract
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the RFC establishes the enduring trust and endorsement semantics, then narrow the API to that approved model.

options.title: Sponsor a constrained evidence endpoint
options.body: Approve a non-endorsement endpoint now, provided it scopes provenance to the selected release, separates current configuration, defines nested schemas, and adds real runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Defer the public v1 contract
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until the RFC establishes the enduring trust and endorsement semantics, then narrow the API to that approved model.
